steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each scope item is matched to the sprint backlog. An item not in the backlog is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Scope item with no rollback step
findings.fix: Add the rollback step and its owner

findings.title: Scope item not in the sprint backlog
findings.fix: Add it to the backlog or remove it

findings.title: Scope item has no gate
findings.fix: Name the gate it must pass

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 2 medium).
[high] scope-payments.md:12  Scope item with no rollback step.
       Fix: Add the rollback step and its owner.
[medium] scope-reports.md:19  Scope item not in the sprint backlog.
       Fix: Add it to the backlog or remove it.
[medium] scope-audit.md:26  Scope item has no gate.
       Fix: Name the gate it must pass.
Not checked: Whether the rollback works.
pros: Flags an item with no gate, an item with no rollback, and a scope item not in the sprint backlog.
cons: Not checked: Whether the rollback works.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-devops-sprint-release-plan skill on the records for this review.
